title: Donate
intro: Give Salinas kids a chance to surf, build confidence, and find a positive path forward.
receipt_note: You will receive a tax receipt for a donation made through this form. We fundraise with Zeffy so that 100% of your donation goes to our work.

ways.title: Donate funds
ways.text: Helps cover surfboards, wetsuits, permits, and program costs.

ways.title: Food and snacks
ways.text: We provide breakfast, snacks, and everything needed to fuel the day.

ways.title: Transportation
ways.text: We provide the ride to and from the beach. Every dollar helps.
